key_insight: CloakFEM shows that valid, solvable FEM programs can act as efficiency attacks, dramatically increasing solver work without causing execution failure.
engineering_relevance: Simulation services may need resource-aware safeguards because successful FEM execution does not guarantee computationally safe workloads.
method: Use an LLM agent to search for computationally expensive FEM programs.
Guide generation with an FEM-specific intermediate representation.
Apply a deterministic validity gate to enforce runnable constraints.
evidence_signal: Across three FEM stacks, 17 problem classes, and 1,068 seeds, CloakFEM outperformed five generic black-box baselines; the largest reported iteration increase was 43 to 247,367 (5,752.72×).
watch_item: Iteration amplification is not necessarily proportional to wall-clock slowdown, and vulnerability may depend on the solver and problem configuration.
paper_title: CloakFEM: Agentic FEM Code Generation for Red-Teaming Computational Resource Exhaustion
